title: t8y2/dbx
claim: t8y2/dbx — 20 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 70+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB,
why_good: A 20MB cross-platform client for 70+ databases, extremely active (150 contributors, 1,438 commits/30d) — a lean TablePlus.
value: DB clients monetize as a paid pro/team tier (TablePlus and DBeaver both do): sync, collaboration, enterprise.
risk: Crowded (DBeaver / TablePlus / DataGrip); needs a sharp wedge — size/speed — to pull paying users off incumbents.

zh.claim: t8y2/dbx —— 20MB 轻量跨平台数据库客户端,支持 70+ 种数据库(MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB…)。
zh.why_good: 一个 20MB、支持 70+ 数据库的跨平台客户端,极活跃(150 贡献者、1438 提交/30天)——精简版 TablePlus。
zh.value: 数据库客户端靠付费专业/团队版变现(TablePlus、DBeaver 都这么做):同步、协作、企业版。
zh.risk: 很挤(DBeaver/TablePlus/DataGrip);要靠体积/速度的锋利切口把付费用户从现有产品撬走。
